## Checklist

- [ ] Checked each id with `cdda_check.py`: description followed, volume ratio about 0.75–1.45 (or the reason given)
- [ ] Worn items and odd features are 3D blocks, not only paint
- [ ] Stands on y = 0, faces −Z, 1 unit = 1 m
- [ ] Effects, if any, move only `fx_*` nodes in the `FX` clip
- [ ] `meshset.json` entry with `author`, `license` and `source`
- [ ] The work is my own and released under CC BY-SA 3.0, or it is an outside model under a compatible licence, credited in `CREDITS.md`
